basis: Classified on 30 October 2026 from the inspected evidence recorded on 26 October 2026: captions, headers, cover frames, images and, where opened, every carousel slide. Execution for the 21 reels was added on 1 November 2026 from a frame review of each video (see the video review method); themes stay as classified from the captions.

guide.unit: One record per unique attributed post (post ID and URL from social.json). The 19 @tryramp records are not classified while their provider attribution is unresolved.
guide.theme: One primary theme per post, from what the caption and inspected visuals are about. Primary themes are mutually exclusive and sum to the brand’s post count. Secondary tags may overlap and never change primary counts.
themes: Explains what a product does or how to use it.
A named customer’s situation, switch or result.
A time-limited offer, rate, contest or entry call.
Sponsorships and creator partnerships, where the partner is the subject.
Events the brand hosts or attends, launches and appearances.
Team life and community programmes, such as awards or founder cohorts.
Ideas or advice for business readers, not about the brand’s product.
guide.format: Image, carousel or video, as recorded at collection.
guide.approach: How the message is delivered, established by visual review: images, fully opened carousels and, since 1 November 2026, each reel reviewed as frames across its full length with on-screen text read (audio not heard). The part before the colon is the execution type counted on the page; the rest describes the post.
guide.other_fields: Audience suggested by the content, product promoted, customer problem or benefit, proof, call to action and the opening line of the caption (not a verified video hook). Proof, call to action and the caption opening are taken from the existing post records; this file adds the classification and its basis.
guide.unclear: Where the evidence does not support a label, the field says so.

metrics_rules.interactions: Visible likes plus comments, only when both counts are present and exact.
metrics_rules.approximate: A count shown abbreviated (such as 1.5K) is kept as displayed and treated as approximate; it is excluded from medians.
metrics_rules.missing: A missing count is not zero; the post is excluded from medians.
metrics_rules.views: Views were read from each account’s Reels tab at a separate time and are reported separately, never added to interactions.
metrics_rules.age: Counts are lifetime counts at collection. Older posts had more time to collect interactions, so they are not age-normalised.
metrics_rules.paid: A paid-partnership label does not show whether distribution was paid for; paid distribution is unknown.
metrics_rules.pattern: A theme with fewer than three usable posts is shown descriptively and not treated as a pattern. Three or more posts still do not establish reliability.

video_review.method: The 21 attributed reels were collected with the official Apify actor apify/instagram-scraper on 31 October 2026 at 8:03 p.m. Toronto time (founder-approved after Instagram showed a sign-in wall to a signed-out browser). Each video was downloaded and reviewed on 1 November 2026 as frames spread evenly across its full length (16 per reel, 24 for the 140-second Queen’s interview), with on-screen text and subtitles read. Audio was not heard, so anything said aloud and not subtitled is not assessed. The 12 @tryramp reels were not collected.
video_review.private: The collector output, its signed media links and the video files stay private; only their SHA-256 hashes are recorded here.
